# Current-to-target boundary: TeacherOrchestrator and Dialog

Status: the ownership/delivery direction, action-context runtime, bounded
general-teacher runtime, and exact selected-text lesson runtime were accepted
and implemented on 2026-08-31. Whole-lesson tutoring without a selection is not
part of this contract.

## RESOLVED OWNERSHIP

1. `PersonalTeacher` is a first-class logical author, never a synthetic
   `ms-go-user` account.
2. `ms-go-dialog` owns authoritative history, ordering, unread state,
   moderation, idempotent append, and realtime delivery.
3. A teacher dialog binds one real student, one `personal_teacher_id`, and one
   educational context. Task/project messages also bind the exact
   `learning_action_id`.
4. A committed student message emits the durable, body-free
   `dialog.teacher.requested` trigger.
5. Teacher reads only the exact source plus at most 49 prior messages through a
   token-protected internal Dialog route.
6. Teacher appends through a token-protected idempotent command. Dialog verifies
   the bound PersonalTeacher and publishes the normal message event used by
   REST/WebSocket clients.
7. Teacher owns private orchestration/delivery state but never a second
   queryable dialog history.

## IMPLEMENTED PRODUCER CONTRACT

`ms-go-dialog` implements:

- teacher dialogs and logical PersonalTeacher authorship;
- `general_teacher|lesson|lesson_task|practice_task|project` bindings;
- message-level LearningAction binding for action contexts;
- transactional `dialog.teacher.requested` publication in `DIALOG_EVENTS`;
- bounded internal request-context read;
- idempotent teacher-response append;
- normal Dialog history and WebSocket delivery for the committed response.

## IMPLEMENTED TEACHER RUNTIME

This repository now composes:

- a strict schema-v1 trigger decoder and durable JetStream subscriber;
- `teacher_dialog_job`, with one event/source identity, fenced leases, retries,
  blocked state, and pending-delivery recovery;
- bounded Student and Dialog context reads for `general_teacher`, `lesson`,
  `lesson_task`, `practice_task`, and `project`;
- deterministic `teacher-dialog-policy-v1` with progressive help levels 1–7;
- confidential AI Prompt `teacher.response.v1` execution and committed-result
  replay;
- atomic decision, `teacher.decision.recorded` outbox, and pending response
  persistence;
- idempotent Dialog append using the source event ID, followed by response-body
  deletion after verified delivery.
- source-channel persistence and optional leased Telegram delivery keyed by the
  source message, without a second history or teacher identity.

The NATS message is acknowledged only after durable job acceptance or an
identical duplicate. Invalid envelopes and conflicting identity reuse terminate;
transient persistence failure retries. Private Student/Dialog snapshots, prompt
variables, rendered prompts, provider responses, and chain-of-thought are never
stored.

The default-dark S5 cut keeps one Teacher conversation over Dialog v2 events:
a materialized canonical assistant-ui action is deterministic and makes zero
LLM calls; free text attached to a frozen active prompt makes at most one AI
Prompt semantic call. Student remains the sole mutation owner. High-impact
proposals become a Teacher-owned per-answer confirmation block, while Dialog
read/validation failures fail closed. `TEACHER_UNIFIED_COORDINATOR_ENABLED`
remains false by default; Next automatic reply/enablement is S7, not S5.

S7 adds that default-dark automatic reply behind
`TEACHER_PRODUCT_AWARE_ONBOARDING_ENABLED`. Frozen prompt policy v1 replays
unchanged; policy v2 identifies its behavior independently of the live flag.
After an accepted v2 Student effect, the coordinator proves the exact S3
receipt, reads state-fenced Planner readiness, and atomically stages one
deterministic response. `no_effect`, tangents, and already staged responses
make no readiness call. Invalid, stale, or unavailable results keep the turn
and cursor blocked. S7 does not call the S8 path-planning mutation.

The model cannot choose the pedagogical action or increase help. The
deterministic ladder starts with a Socratic question and progresses through
direction, concept reminder, analogous example, pseudocode, partial structure,
and guided breakdown. A complete solution is never permitted. Only a bounded
business reason is recorded.

## GENERAL CONTEXT

Student now exposes a provider-neutral learner overview containing optional
declared onboarding and at most 20 recent current mastery projections. General
teacher requests use this projection transiently, select a non-hint adaptive
response plan, correlate the decision by dialog ID, and never treat declared
experience as diagnosed mastery. Migration 008 safely requeues only untouched
general jobs previously blocked as unsupported.

## SELECTED-TEXT LESSON CONTEXT

Each `lesson` source message carries the current Course revision and an exact
non-empty selected fragment. Teacher reads current active canonical Course
content, requires the revision and substring to match exactly, and sends only
the verified fragment to deterministic pedagogy and AI Prompt. Course's full
snapshot is transient and is never persisted in Teacher or forwarded wholesale
to a model. A stale revision, forged fragment, inactive lesson, deleted source,
or malformed anchor fails closed. Course currently exposes current
`lesson.updated_at`, not immutable history, so edits intentionally invalidate
older queued questions.

Whole-lesson tutoring without a selected fragment remains unsupported until an
owner can prove the student's current position and content access.

## KNOWLEDGE TREE CONCLUSION

No direct Knowledge Tree dependency is necessary for the implemented action
pipeline. Course or the immutable practice catalog authors provider-neutral
targets, Student freezes the exact projection on the LearningAction, and Teacher
uses those same references without traversing a graph. The selected-text lesson
flow likewise relies on ownership-scoped Student/Course projections rather than
direct graph access.
